title: Fock-state filtering of squeezed states: enhanced nonclassicality and effects of a thermal bath
summary: The ability to tailor photon-number statistics is central to the generation and control of nonclassical states of light. Here, we investigate how Fock-state filtering of squeezed coherent states can be used to engineer their photon statistics. We consider the selective removal of the $m=0$ and $m=1$ Fock components and show that this process can enhance the sub-Poissonian character of the field, depending on the coherent amplitude.
